metadata.description: Procedural building GLB generator for Unreal Engine, Unity and three.js.

plugins.name: glb-buildings
plugins.description: Build and edit buildings as named projects through one CLI: a JSON document of floor sections becomes a validated, low poly GLB that opens in Unreal Engine, Unity and three.js, with a three.js blueprint preview where a click picks a bay and a dragged rectangle marks a zone.
